newsitem.title: USA: United Health, N.J., takeover challenged -- paper.
newsitem.headline: United Health, N.J., takeover challenged -- paper.

text.p: A week after Saint Barnabas Health Care System won bidding for the bankrupt United Healthcare System in Newark, other bidders have filed a legal challenge to the agreement, the Star Ledger reported Thursday.
The state-run University of Medicine and Dentistry of New Jersey and Newark's Cathedral Healthcare System petitioned a federal bankruptcy court to award them the assets of United.
The challenge to the Saint Barnabas agreement argues that the competing bids would be better for Newark, and that the state acted improperly in designating Saint Barnabas the successor to United.
They said they have a submitted a competing bid that is higher than Saint Barnabas's, and preserves more jobs.
The case is set for its first hearing Thursday before U.S. Bankruptcy Court Judge William Tuohy.
